_description: V2 audit entries for RawAuditEventV2 (Rust, Go) and canonicalizer contrast (TS, Python, Go, Rust). Each entry (or entry_json, given as text) has its dcp-jcs-v1 text, written by hand, and its SHA-256. The entries are preservation and canonicalization data with simplified identifiers, timestamps and hashes (a, t, sha256:i), not schema-validity vectors: schema_valid false marks an entry whose exercised member the audit_entry schema or the V2-11 erratum rejects (kept because a lossless type keeps invalid evidence too), and its absence does not attest schema validity. Only string_evidence_bundle carries a verification control. string_evidence_bundle verifies at verification_time under verifier_policy; its entries carry nothing the typed Rust and Go structs lose, so each mutation (set value at path, or delete it, in audit_entries[entry_index]) isolates one change.
_randomness: Keys come from fixed seeds, Ed25519 signatures are deterministic and signature.created_at is fixed; ML-DSA-65 signatures are hedged with fresh entropy, so a new run writes different bytes in the five composite_sig.pq.sig_b64 members, and nowhere else. The committed file is the artifact.
